model: reServer Industrial J501 carrier + Jetson AGX Orin 32GB + Seeed heatsink with fan, in the j501-agx printed enclosure
price_note: Sum of parts, no single retail SKU: AGX Orin 32GB module $900 (Diamond Systems listing; resellers range $900-1,179), J501 carrier $379 and heatsink with fan $49 (Seeed store). Printed enclosure filament is extra (see the j501-agx print package). GMSL board ($59) not included: the default build has no GMSL camera.

specs.mass_note: Carrier 225 g and GMSL board 47 g are from the Seeed datasheet. Module and heatsink masses are not published. The enclosure figure is an estimate, not a measurement. Weigh the assembled box.
specs.usb: 3x USB 3.1 Type-A, 1x USB 3.1 Type-C (host), 1x USB 2.0 Type-C (device)
specs.camera_expansion: 2x Samtec QSH-030-01-L-D-A (60-pin), 8 MIPI CSI-2 lanes each. Not the AGX Orin devkit's 120-pin camera connector.
specs.gmsl_extension_board: 2x MAX96724 deserializers, 8 GMSL1/GMSL2 inputs on 4-port FM4-NZRP jacks, 12 V PoC through MAX20087, 103 x 45 mm, -20 to 60 C
specs.other_io: 4x DI, 4x DO, HDMI 2.1, 2x SATA III, M.2 Key M (PCIe 4.0), M.2 Key B, M.2 Key E, Mini PCIe
specs.mass_estimate_note: ESTIMATE until weighed: carrier 225 g (Seeed datasheet) + module ~300 g + heatsink with fan ~400 g (both unpublished, guessed from size) + printed enclosure ~450 g (j501-agx part volumes, PLA at ~60% effective fill) + fasteners and cables ~100 g.
specs.dimensions_axes: Enclosure (j501-agx Rev 0.7, robot build P1M base): L = 206 mm along X (side hatch on the +X wall), W = 181 mm along Y (front plate at Y = 5.5 with DC IN, 1GbE, 10GbE, audio, LED, GMSL; rear plate at Y = 186.5 with I/O terminal, HDMI, USB-A, USB-C), H = 112 mm (base 72 + lid 40; hex-grille roof is the fan inlet). Mounting tabs add 26 mm at floor level on the front and rear faces: footprint 206 x 233 mm.
specs.dimensions_mm_basis: measured-from-CAD (j501-agx exports/base_mount.step bbox 206 x 233 x 76.5 incl. tabs, cover.step 206 x 181 x 40; exports/design-metrics.json envelope.outer_mm)

mounting.type: 4 tabs on the base floor (P1M), 8 mm thick, 32 mm wide, projecting 26 mm from the front and rear faces
mounting.pattern_axes: 154 mm along the 206 mm side (X), 211 mm along the 181 mm side (Y); centred on the box footprint
mounting.slot_centres_frame: X from the -X wall, Y from the front face (front face Y = 0, rear face Y = 181); slots are 15 mm outside each face

specs.orientation_cooling: Keep the hex-grille roof clear: the Seeed cooler fan draws air in through the roof (50 % open, 10 mm A/F cells) and out through the lid side/end slots and base side slots. Do not mount anything over the roof or block the side vents; the box is designed roof-up. Front and rear faces carry the plugs and need cable bend room (RJ45, USB, DC IN plug sticks out 9.9 mm before its cable).
specs.printed_enclosure_volume_basis: measured-from-CAD: base_mount 317.64 + cover 198.33 + front_no_gmsl 30.77 + rear_io 29.45 + side_hatch 8.78 + chimney_cap (P18 floor cap) 1.81 cm3 (j501-agx exports/geometry-checks.json)
specs.printed_enclosure_mass_basis: estimate: 586.8 cm3 of solid PLA at 1.24 g/cm3 = 728 g if printed solid; ~75 % effective fill for these 3-6 mm walls gives ~545 g. No print profile is stored in the j501-agx exports, so weigh the prints.
specs.mass_g_basis: estimate (same as mass_g_estimate: carrier 225 g datasheet + module, cooler and printed enclosure estimated); weigh the assembled box

notes: Runs directly from 4S-8S packs (12-36 V input; 8S full is 33.6 V). The Seeed GMSL board only has published support for Seeed SENSING cameras. Stereolabs and RealSense publish no GMSL driver for it, and the ZED Link Duo cannot plug into the J501 (wrong connector). The box is the heaviest single payload item; mount it low on the torso, near the hip axis. Enclosure geometry and mounting recorded 2026-10-26 from the j501-agx repo (Rev 0.7); the j501-agx repo stores part volumes but no mass properties, so the enclosure mass stays an estimate. Not verified (2026-10-26): AGX Orin module and Seeed cooler masses (unpublished; the 1500 g total is still an estimate); printed enclosure mass (no slicer profile in the repo).

notes: Minimum range is not published. Rotor mass and inertia are not published. Needs a clear 360 deg horizon; the lowest beam is 15 deg below horizontal. Spinning at 5-20 Hz puts rotor-imbalance vibration in the balance controller's band, so keep its IMU path filtered. Gyroscopic torque from a pitching chassis appears about the roll axis (upper-bound estimate in research/sensors-compute.md). Base pattern from the datasheet drawing: centre 1/4-20 x 7.1 deep plus 2 dowel holes for 5/32 in pins 88.9 mm apart, perpendicular to the cable exit. Not verified (2026-10-26): no official STEP; build a simple cylinder model from the datasheet; which dowel hole is the slot (drawing shows the 0-deg-side-top one as elongated) and slot length; cable + Interface Box mass.

model: VLP-16 Interface Box (enclosure drawing 50-6001 Rev B, schematic 69-8230 Rev A)
price_note: Ships with the sensor; no separate public price.

specs.dimensions_note: Not published as overall dimensions. Manual drawing 50-6001 Rev B shows a flanged Polycase enclosure with 2 flange mounting holes; overall size is not dimensioned.
specs.voltage_note: The box does not regulate. Input passes through a 3.0 A fuse to the sensor, with a 5KP30A TVS (30 V standoff) across it. The sensor's 9-18 V limit therefore applies at the barrel jack.
specs.power_input: 5.5 mm OD x 2.5 mm ID barrel jack (PJ-102A), center positive. Also a red/black terminal block inside.
specs.connectors: RJ45 Ethernet (100 Mbps); DC barrel; GPS port SM06B-SRSS-TB (6-pin); internal screw terminals for GPS PPS/serial
specs.internal_regulator: MC7805 (5 V, GPS receiver supply only)

notes: Do NOT connect a 6S (18.0-25.2 V) or 7S (21-29.4 V) pack directly. Both exceed the sensor's 18 V maximum, and the TVS does not clamp until ~33 V. Feed it from a regulated 12 V DC-DC rated for at least 3 A (spin-up surge). The manual allows replacing the box with a custom harness if you add equivalent fuse, reverse and over-voltage protection (manual 5.4.2). Do not cut the cable without a Velodyne waiver (minimum length requirement).
